title: DGCA Drone Rules and Regulations
description: This course provides a practical introduction to Indian drone laws, Digital Sky airspace zones, drone registration, remote pilot requirements and essential safety and compliance practices. It is designed for aspiring drone pilots, students, operators and professionals who want a structured understanding of responsible drone operations in India.
topics: Module 1: Introduction to DGCA Drone Regulations
Module 3: Digital Sky and Airspace Regulations
Module 6: Legal Responsibilities and Drone Compliance

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to DGCA Drone Regulations
items: Overview of drone regulations in India
Role of DGCA and the Ministry of Civil Aviation
Responsibilities of drone owners, operators and pilots

modules.title: Module 2: Drone Classification and Registration
items: Drone registration and Unique Identification Number

modules.title: Module 3: Digital Sky and Airspace Regulations
items: Introduction to the Digital Sky platform
Green, yellow and red airspace zones
Restrictions near airports and sensitive locations
Overview of flight permissions and approvals

modules.title: Module 4: Remote Pilot Requirements
items: Role and responsibilities of a remote pilot
Overview of the Remote Pilot Certificate
Role of Remote Pilot Training Organisations

modules.title: Module 5: Safe Drone Operating Practices
items: Safe take-off, flight and landing practices

modules.title: Module 6: Legal Responsibilities and Drone Compliance
items: Privacy and responsible aerial data collection
Standard operating procedures and compliance examples

outcome: -  Understand the basic drone rules applicable in India -  Recognise common drone classifications -  Understand registration and identification requirements -  Interpret Digital Sky airspace zones -  Identify key remote-pilot responsibilities -  Apply basic safety and compliance practices

title: FAA Drone Rules and Regulations
description: This course introduces the principal drone regulations and operating requirements followed in the United States. Learners gain awareness of recreational flying, FAA Part 107, drone registration, Remote ID, airspace authorisation and remote-pilot responsibilities.
topics: Module 1: Introduction to FAA Drone Regulations
Module 3: Drone Registration and Remote ID

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to FAA Drone Regulations
items: Role of the Federal Aviation Administration
Introduction to the National Airspace System

modules.title: Module 2: Recreational and Part 107 Operations
items: Introduction to the TRUST safety test
Purpose and scope of FAA Part 107

modules.title: Module 3: Drone Registration and Remote ID
Module 4: Airspace and Flight Authorisation
items: Introduction to LAANC and DroneZone authorisations
Airports, restricted areas and temporary restrictions

modules.title: Module 6: Pilot Responsibilities and Compliance
items: Overview of waivers and special authorisations

outcome: -  Differentiate recreational and Part 107 operations -  Understand registration and Remote ID requirements -  Recognise common US airspace classifications -  Understand LAANC and FAA DroneZone -  Identify remote-pilot responsibilities -  Apply essential safety and compliance practices

title: EASA Drone Rules and Regulations
description: This course provides a practical introduction to the European drone regulatory framework. It covers EASA operation categories, Open-category subcategories, operator registration, remote-pilot competency, geographical zones and essential compliance responsibilities.
topics: Module 1: Introduction to EASA Drone Regulations
Module 5: Geographical Zones and Safe Operations

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to EASA Drone Regulations
items: Role of EASA and National Aviation Authorities

modules.title: Module 5: Geographical Zones and Safe Operations
items: Operations near airports and restricted locations

outcome: -  Understand the European drone regulatory framework -  Differentiate Open, Specific and Certified categories -  Recognise A1, A2 and A3 subcategories -  Understand registration and pilot competency -  Identify geographical-zone restrictions -  Apply basic European drone compliance practices

title: Aerospace Engineering Fundamentals
description: This course introduces the essential principles behind aircraft, spacecraft and unmanned aerial systems. It provides a structured foundation in aerodynamics, flight mechanics, performance, structures, propulsion, stability, control systems, avionics and introductory spaceflight concepts without requiring advanced mathematics.
topics: Module 2: Atmosphere and Principles of Flight
Module 4: Aircraft Performance and Flight Mechanics
Module 7: Stability, Control, Avionics and Spaceflight Basics
